shellCommands.command: cat package.json; cat next.config.*; git status --short; find app src -type f 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head -50
for f in app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx 'app/projects/[slug]/page.tsx'; do echo "== $f"; cat "$f"; done; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/; grep -ril "prefetch" node_modules/next/dist/docs | head -30

cd node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference; cat 03-file-conventions/02-route-segment-config/prefetch.md; echo =====; cat 03-file-conventions/02-route-segment-config/instant.md | head -150; echo ====; cat 05-config/01-next-config-js/partialPrefetching.md; ls /workspace/lib 2>&1; cat /workspace/lib/* 2>/dev/null
cd node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app; cat 03-api-reference/04-functions/prefetch.md; echo =====; cat $(grep -rl "title: Optimizing prefetching" . | head -1)
